job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is an SFERS RFP for general investment consulting services, not KCERA’s audit-services RFP. Its three-year initial term is coincidental; the extension provisions differ: SFERS has two one-year options exercisable at its sole discretion, not an extension of up to three years by mutual agreement.
quotes: Request for Proposals for General Investment Consulting Services for the City and County of San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System
The contracts anticipated under this RFP will have an initial term of three (3) years.
SFERS shall have two (2) options to extend the term of the agreements for a period of one (1) year which SFERS may exercise in its sole and absolute discretion.
